operatorBearer.description: The operator credential in the dashboard's private viewer-token file. It grants inspection of private configuration and access to operator actions.

info.description: Loom's dashboard observation and operator HTTP API. Parameters and data types are projected from its ESS model. A2A runs on each individual agent listener.

post.description: Send one bounded text message to a registered host with the dashboard operator credential and the host’s A2A bearer.

parameters.description: The input field `agent`, carried in the path rather than the request body.
parameters.name: agent

200.description: Outcome `dispatched`, answered 200 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with the command's response, bare: no `outcome` names the branch and no `published` lists what it published.

400.description: Outcome `invalid`, answered 400 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `invalid_request`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names.

401.description: Outcome `denied`, answered 401 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `unauthorized`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names.

actor.description: The qualified name of the actor the request was authenticated as, or null where it was authenticated as none.

refused.description: The standard refusal for an actor no grant admits.

403.description: Outcome `forbidden`, answered 403 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `forbidden`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names. Outcome `agent-denied`, answered 403 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `agent_unauthorized`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names. No declared outcome: the standard refusal for an actor no grant admits: the request was authenticated as no actor, or as one `x-ess-may-invoke` does not list. It is checked before the command runs, so nothing was read, written or published, and the same request from a granted actor is decided by the command. Its body carries `refused` and `actor`, never the `outcome` and `error` a declared branch carries.

404.description: Outcome `not-found`, answered 404 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `not_found`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names.

409.description: Outcome `offline`, answered 409 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `agent_unavailable`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names.

503.description: Outcome `unavailable-viewers`, answered 503 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `viewer_configuration_unavailable`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names. Outcome `unavailable-dispatch`, answered 503 as the `ess-http/1` binding declares, with an object whose `error` is `dispatch_unavailable`, beside the error's own fields under their wire names.
